required_fields_and_period: Latest complete calendar year and 2021/2022 bridge; petrol/diesel production, imports, exports, stock changes and statistical differences; units and coverage
acceptance_test: Reconcile definitions and source revisions; no residual labelled as production

required_fields_and_period: Latest 36 complete months; terminal, product, origin, destination, customer ID, receipt/dispatch m3; flag Durban-Lesedi transfers and final customer deliveries
acceptance_test: Deduplicate chain deliveries; reconcile monthly totals to operating reports

required_fields_and_period: Tank/product gross and working m3; unavailable/committed capacity; stock policy; actual turns; monthly receipt/dispatch m3; hourly and peak limits; downtime
acceptance_test: Eligible working tankage and achievable throughput reconciled by product and terminal

required_fields_and_period: Same petrol/diesel spec and inland destination; dated product basis and handling/road/rail/pipeline/border/loss/finance costs; tax basis, currency, transit time, access rights and available annual capacity
acceptance_test: Compare same product/date/destination; confirm tanker access and service availability

required_fields_and_period: Anonymised customer/product/destination annual m3; sourcing alternatives, contract dates, committed vs contestable volumes and renewal assumptions
acceptance_test: Mutually exclusive customer pools; confirmed rights and no assumed capacity-share proxy

required_fields_and_period: Incremental storage/handling revenue, variable and fixed costs; tank/debottleneck capex, schedule, ramp-up, working capital, tax, hurdle rate and asset life; effects on existing revenue
acceptance_test: Compare existing assets, debottleneck and expansion on incremental cash flows

required_fields_and_period: Product/sector activity, transferable freight tonne-km, rail traction, EV fleet replacement, ICE efficiency; Eskom/IPP/private backup separately; generation commissioning and retirements
acceptance_test: No rail/EV/efficiency double count; power balance and dispatch constrain diesel

required_fields_and_period: SAPREF funded timing/ramp/yields; Natref availability/utilisation; Secunda gas/MRG liquids penalty; PetroSA feedstock/restart; product-specific annual output
acceptance_test: Nameplate converted to output; dependencies and scenario consistency reviewed

required_fields_and_period: Customer energy and charging demand; utilisation by location; power connection and tariff; capex, costs, commercial terms, partner model and strategic mandate
proposed_data_provider: Potential customers / Vopak strategy / power partners
acceptance_test: Standalone customer, power-access and incremental-return case; not inferred from low fuel demand
